perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

enhanced.name: Elemental Capacitor
enhanced.description:
Substantially increases stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

enhanced.name: Trench Barrel
enhanced.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, improved handling, and improved reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Cascade Point
enhanced.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for an improved duration.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

enhanced.name: Voltshot
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Butterfly
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.
